title: Security for the agentic era, powered by Microsoft Perception
content_md: In this article A new cyber stack, built to fight AI with AI Delivering agentic security at Microsoft Ignite Secure your foundations Defend with agents Secure agentic insiders Changing how security work gets done Explore what's new A year ago, finding a serious, exploitable vulnerability was slow and expensive work done by elite security researchers. That’s no longer true. Over the past 12 months, frontier AI models have become remarkably good at discovering and exploiting software vulnerabilities, and similar levels of capability are quickly becoming available in open weights models with limited cyber guardrails. Attacks that once required specialized resources are now within reach of almost anyone. We saw what that looks like in a single week this fall when PHP disclosed two critical remote code execution (RCE) vulnerabilities, flaws that let an attacker take control of a server with a single request over the internet. 1 At the time of disclosure, tens of millions of internet-facing PHP services were running affected versions. Nearly two weeks later, about 29 million services remained vulnerable. Behind those servers are banks, healthcare providers, energy companies, and much of the infrastructure the internet runs on. And that same day brought five other major disclosures across the industry.
